Name: Purple Cats
Author: Jenonen
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Change all cats to purple cats.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]To install this mod, navigate to your game's directory. You can do this with these instructions:
[/color][/size]
1) Navigate to your Steam library and locate Stardew Valley.

2) Right click on Stardew Valley and go to "Properties...".

3) Go to "Installed Files".

4) Click on "Browse..." This will open your game's directory.

5) Go into the folder called "Mods".

6) Place "[CP] Purple Cats.zip inside the "Mods" folder.

7) Extract the .zip file by right-clicking "[CP] Purple Cats.zip", then in the menu that pops up, click on "Extract All..."

8) In the "Extract Compressed (Zipped) Folders" window, click on "Extract".

9) The mod is now installed!


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Change all cats to purple cats. That's really it.[/color]
